description: Dreamfolks Services Limited provides benefit management services through technology platforms that tailor airport and lifestyle service offerings in India. It provides airport and railway lounge access, meet and assist, golf access, spa, visa assistance and transit hotels, private club membership, airport food and beverage outlets, grooming, airport transfer, healthcare, buffets at hotels, room upgrades, and wellness services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Gurugram, India.
